objective: Make the Bible reader genuinely edge-to-edge with zero horizontal card/scroll gutter and keep the existing Matthew Henry commentary shortcut visible above persistent bottom navigation.
productionBaselineEvidence: Canonical main 0f8e8a6a3747e882870d1accada9c136c8f35548 at branch start. Nov16 staging OTA 01a1e27b-0009-7e15-a0fd-e2207701a55e and existing Henry source. User screenshot shows 1 Kings 4 verses with broad left/right gutters and no visible Henry shortcut.
chosenApproach: Keep the existing My Bible commentary provider, verse-level source gating, modal and toolbar unchanged. Remove only outer scroll and verse-card horizontal padding and tighten verse rows; lift the existing floating Henry button above persistent bottom nav without changing its source/translation behavior.
selectionRationale: The source already has a real Matthew Henry action; creating another provider or replacing chapter data would duplicate logic. CSS-only layout corrections fix the photographed issue with minimum regression risk.
alternativeApproaches: Remove bottom navigation in Bible: rejected, breaks canonical five-tab shell.
Always show invented Henry per-verse commentary: rejected, source coverage is sparse and must remain truthful.
Increase reader font/zoom: rejected, does not address wasted horizontal gutter.
preserveBehaviors: Existing commentary exact-source gating and Original English/Google translation remain unchanged
Daily-plan reading, TTS, Strong's, notes and verse selection remain functional
Persistent bottom nav remains visible and clickable
Maintain bottom scroll inset to prevent last verse clipping
Do not touch AdMob or other app modules
acceptanceChecks: Verse card has zero padding and margin
Henry shortcut is rendered above persistent navigation
Existing chapter commentary and verse-level buttons remain source-gated
